newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P says affirms Sumitomo Corp's "A-1" ratings.
newsitem.headline: S&P says affirms Sumitomo Corp's "A-1" ratings.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Thursday that it had affirmed its short-term "A-1" ratings of Sumitomo Corp and its subsidiaries Sumitomo Corp Capital Europe and Sumitomo Corp of America.
At the same time, S&P said it had taken Sumitomo Corp off CreditWatch, where it was placed on June 14 following the firm's announcement of losses from unauthorized copper trades.
S&P said the short-term ratings of Sumitomo's two subsidiaries benefited from a support agreement from Sumitomo Corp, one of the largest general trading companies in Japan.

"Following its recognition of 285 billion yen in copper-trading related losses in September, Sumitomo appears to have put behind it the most serious problems from the scandal," S&P said in a statement.
